CLI.security_boundary: CLI is not public HTTP and grants no Owner/path/command authority; future worker must whitelist argv, roots and staged descriptor/source pins

required: verified parent raw-QC source/result manifest/artifact SHAs
explicit params and immutable derived version/parent lineage
exact output bytes/complete manifest verification and durable publication/DB unknown semantics

inputs.encoding: complete UTF8 with optional BOM; NUL refused; TSV quote disabled; no trim, comments, fill or NA token coercion

flags.invalid_present_even_when_disabled: refuse entire input before output creation
flags.missing_enabled: refuse entire input before output creation

inputs.numeric: same nonnegative finite R-double token/overflow/underflow safeguards as reviewed raw QC; only exactly empty token is blank; nonempty NA/NaN/Inf/negative/junk refuses entire input including excluded rows
inputs.required_source_header: Protein IDs; no split/dedup/rewrite of its raw group text
inputs.selected_binding: all and only original columns of given family, 0-based canonical decimal ordinal and exact header/label/family, in original order
inputs.snapshots: full bytes reread/identical before and after parsing, before output creation and before success marker; not a SHA/FD/Owner proof

logic.filter_union: enabled exact-positive causes union; reason counts may overlap; excluded total is union, not sum
logic.imputed: all FALSE; no generated values or seed
logic.masks_scope: retained rows and selected columns; same prefixes/order/dimensions as both matrices
logic.original_blank: exact source empty token; still recorded separately from working NA
logic.original_zero: nonblank numeric zero, including e.g. +0.0e0; never transformed to NA
logic.parent_raw_QC_full_row_masks_and_source: immutable and unchanged; this standalone script neither updates them nor proves their hashes
logic.raw_retained: exact original selected tokens for kept source rows
logic.row_map_and_filter_log_scope: all original input rows in original order
logic.source_unit: original 1-based proteinGroups row, no member expansion or dedup
logic.working_NA: only original_blank in this identity slice
logic.working_matrix: numeric finite values represented with R sprintf %.17g; source blank serialized NA; numeric zero remains zero

outputs.TSV: UTF8 LF, quote=TRUE, double quote escaping, no row names; types/header/order must validate; expected fixture tables compare parsed cells, not R quoting bytes

exact_allowlist_and_headers.R-session-info.txt: nonempty UTF8 utils::sessionInfo() capture; actual R/package/startup provenance checked by future trusted runner

failure.I_O_failure_after_directory_creation: may leave partial private outputs; no success; never delete/retry/publish automatically

outputs.numeric_masks_and_count_scopes: source_* counts refer to entire selected family before filtering; retained_* and working_NA/imputed refer only to retained selected cells

success.analyzable: only means nonempty identity work matrix; never PCA/DE/group readiness
